description:
Integrate the full tuning configuration directly into benchmark result output files.

Currently, benchmark results reference the tuning file path but do not capture the
actual tuning configuration content. This is problematic because:
- The tuning file could be modified by subsequent runs
- Results become non-reproducible without the exact tuning config used
- Comparing results across different tuning configs becomes unreliable

Unlike query text (which is deterministically generated from benchmark definitions),
tuning configurations are user-defined and can vary between runs. The actual tuning
content must be captured at execution time to ensure result reproducibility.

Solution: Embed the complete tuning configuration (clauses, indexes, constraints,
etc.) directly in the result output, either inline or as a companion file.
